change_summary: filter_tools now drops the near-unused transfer_to_human_agents and calculate tools from the per-turn exposed tool set.
reason_for_change: Tool schemas are resent every turn across ~28.5 turns/task, so removing two near-unused tools (transfer_to_human_agents: 1 call, calculate: 2 calls) trims fixed per-turn input-token overhead. Since these tools are essentially never invoked, removing them should not change task outcomes, holding success while modestly lowering mean cost per task.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — no cost improvement beyond noise: per-task cost 0.550069 >= threshold 0.549781 (best mean 0.580574 - 1σ·0.030793)
hypothesis: Several tools are never or rarely needed within a given task, yet all 12 tools plus full descriptions are exposed every turn; filtering the tool list to the retail-relevant subset reduces per-turn input token overhead.
